data.body:
[P2] Account for partition locations before reporting writes

`buildCreateTableDdl` enables partition projection under `<root>/year=.../month=.../day=...`. An output location such as `<root>/athena-results/` passes this prefix check but lies outside every projected partition, so those files do not become table rows. The gate nevertheless blocks this safe configuration until the user accepts write access. Determine overlap using the table's partition locations or projection template instead of treating every descendant of `StorageDescriptor.Location` as scanned data.
